CommunityApplications.Profile:
YA-WAMF (Yet Another WhosAtMyFeeder) identifies the birds visiting your feeder from Frigate NVR events using local machine-learning models — no cloud required. It serves a real-time dashboard, correlates visual detections with BirdNET-Go audio, enriches species with iNaturalist taxonomy, and can send notifications.
This repository provides the Unraid Community Applications template for the monolithic Docker image (`ghcr.io/jellman86/yawamf-monalithic`). It needs a reachable Frigate instance publishing events over MQTT.
**Support:** open an issue at https://github.com/Jellman86/YetAnother-WhosAtMyFeeder/issues
